notes: The Great Fact BBSS is an online Alcoholics Anonymous group based in Gorham, ME offering weekly meetings that provide an in-depth exploration of the Big Book of Alcoholics Anonymous. We follow the Hyannis Big Book Step Study format, which emphasizes a structured approach to working the 12 Steps as they are outlined in the Big Book. This is an open meeting.
